2026-08-14.patch_summary: This patch adds a new FUSE_IO_URING_CMD_ADD_QUEUE command to the fuse-over-io-uring implementation, allowing servers to create queues explicitly and decoupling queue setup from entry registration. This is necessary for the FUSE_IO_URING_CMD_ADD_BUFPOOL command, which attaches a buffer pool to an existing queue. The patch modifies the fuse_uring_create_queue function to take an additional parameter indicating whether to fail if the queue already exists, and updates several functions to use this new command.
